news_issues.title: Նվիրատվությանը նախորդած կամ հաջորդած շինթույլտվությունների տրամադրումը դասական կոռուպցիա է. փորձագետ
news_issues.summary: Noy Invest Group was among four companies (with Renshin etc.) whose donations to Yerevan municipality were questioned as possibly linked to building permits; the article states no public coincidences with Noy Invest's permits were found. Earlier donation (benches/bins) reported by armtimes: https://www.armtimes.com/hy/article/226165

Arare's site names per-project builders: NOY complex (Leningradyan/Kirk Kerkorian 21/13) -> “NOY INVEST GROUP” LLC; Nairi residential community (Proshyan) -> “FLAGMAN” LLC; Arare contact email noyinvestgroup@gmail.com ties the brand to Noy Invest Group. Only mild item: municipal-donation/permits scrutiny article (no wrongdoing established for Noy Invest).

news_issues.title: «Զովեր» նորաստեղծ թաղամասի բնակիչների բողոքը
news_issues.summary: Residents of the new 'Zover' district (Kotayk) complain that ~1.5 years after moving in they still have no natural gas connection; developer repeatedly promised a fix 'within 3 months'; sales entity Magnolia Comfort LLC reportedly agreed with Gazprom Armenia that residents pay an extra AMD 700k not in the contract.

news_issues.title: 4 մլրդ դրամանոց պայմանագիր «Զովեր քնսթրաքշն»-ին` ՔՊ-ին գումար նվիրաբերելու դիմաց. «Ժողովուրդ»
news_issues.summary: Zhoghovurd daily (reprinted by Aravot, also armlur.am/1498440): Yerevan municipality signed an AMD 4.75 bn contract with Zover Construction LLC for the Albert Azaryan sports school; shareholders Vardan Khachatryan, Artak Khachatryan and Ara Avetisyan had donated to the ruling Civil Contract party fundraiser. Insinuation of political favouritism, no charges.

positives.title: Completed and sold-out portfolio: Zover Eco Residence (980 apts), Leveloft (192 apts), Kanaker (59 apts); Zard city-district (41 buildings, 26 ha) in pre-sale
positives.summary: Company site claims founding in 2021 and several completed projects; Zard is financed/advertised via Ameriabank's myhome.am with income-tax refund and defence-ministry / Artsakh-refugee housing programmes (spyur).

notes: Brand Zover Estates / Zover Construction (spyur: «ԶՈՎԵՐ ԻՍԹԵՅԹՍ», office Hyusisayin Ave 1, 3rd floor). Zard buildings (myhome.am 334-337) list developer «ՄԱԳՆՈԼԻԱ ԿՈՄՖՈՐՏ» ՍՊԸ with sales@zover.am. «Զովեր քնսթրաքշն» ՍՊԸ is a municipal contractor (shareholders Vardan Khachatryan, Artak Khachatryan, Ara Avetisyan). Aravot article spells the sales LLC «Մանգոլիա Կոմֆորտ» (typo). The gas-connection complaint concerns an earlier completed Zover district (Kotayk), not Zard. Registration year 2021 is the brand's stated founding year, not verified for each LLC.

No legal entity found. 'Armani - Erebuni Multifunctional Complex' at Erebuni 2/1 (19 floors, completion 2024) appears only on karucapatoxic.am/en/110 and novostroiki-yerevan.com, which name the developer by the project name; contact is a personal mail.ru address (mush1994@list.ru). datalex_names are transliterations of the project/brand name. Not on spyur or bank partner lists checked (IDBank, Evoca, Unibank, ACBA). No news found.

news_issues.title: Նվիրատվությանը նախորդած կամ հաջորդած շինթույլտվությունների տրամադրումը դասական կոռուպցիա է. փորձագետ
news_issues.summary: Azatutyun/Hetq: Renshin, Noy Invest Group and others donated property to Yerevan municipality; one donor received four high-rise permits in the centre around the same time; an expert called gifts tied to permits classic corruption. Allegation, no charges reported.

news_issues.title: Սարյանի «Հայփոստի» շենքը կօտարվի «Ռենշինին»
news_issues.summary: Government decided to alienate the Haypost building on Saryan St. to Renshin for the World Trade Center project (overriding public interest); tenants later complained about eviction (azatutyun 2024-08-20, https://www.azatutyun.am/a/hamashkharhayin-arevtri-kentron-haypost--i-shenki-teghoum/33085979.html).

news_issues.title: Երևանի թիվ 172 դպրոցում դասերը հեռավար են. ի՞նչ կապ կա հարակից շինարարության ու դպրոցում նկատված ցնցումների միջև
news_issues.summary: School No.172 evacuated over vibrations the principal linked to Renshin's adjacent Skyline site (Baghramyan-Orbeli, former military hospital); Renshin denied any link, geotechnical firm found no negative effects.

news_issues.title: Գետակ Երևանի կենտրոնում. քանդած ու չփակված ասֆալտի հետևանքները
news_issues.summary: Renshin dug up asphalt on Teryan St for a water main and left it open, causing street flooding during heavy rain; municipality said the company was fined.

news_issues.title: Հանրային խորհրդի նախագահն ընդունել է Թումանյան 25-ի բնակիչներին
news_issues.summary: Residents of Tumanyan 25 protested Renshin's application to have their building declared overriding public interest for a hotel project.

positives.title: Renshin issues first bonds (AMD 10 bn), fully placed, listed on AMX; Ameriabank underwriter; KPMG-audited statements
